sentences.text: Use the deviation for the boat’s heading when correcting a bearing.
Get the signs right: going toward compass, add west; going toward true, add east.
Reading the wrong side of the rose puts your answer exactly one hundred eighty degrees off, and that wrong answer is often one of the choices.
Don’t mix true and magnetic in the same calculation.
And give your answer in whatever the question asks for: true, magnetic or compass.
